annotations.title: Replay a Forge Orbital decision from its inputs

description: Replays a Forge Orbital demo decision: re-runs the deterministic engine on the same sample scenario (and any withdrawn evidence) and checks that the replay key and the decision match the record. Replayability is the point: the same inputs and engine version give the same decision. Reads nothing about the user. Demo only, fictional sample data.
name: replay_decision_record
title: Replay a Forge Orbital decision from its inputs
